preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 20.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 20000 for N in inputs)
preconditions.description: Each number N in the inputs is between 1 and 20000.

postconditions.description: The number of outputs matches the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(output in ['wins', 'loses'] for output in outputs)
all(output == 'wins' if str(N) == str(N)[::-1] else output == 'loses' for N, output in zip(inputs, outputs))
postconditions.description: For each number N, the output is 'wins' if N is a palindrome (reads the same forwards and backwards), otherwise 'loses'.
